name: Myrcene
aroma: Earthy, musky, with hints of ripe fruit
description: The most abundant terpene in modern cannabis cultivars. Myrcene contributes sedative, analgesic, and anti-inflammatory properties. It enhances cellular membrane permeability, allowing faster absorption of beneficial compounds.

name: Limonene
aroma: Bright citrus, lemon zest, orange peel
description: A monocyclic monoterpene prevalent in citrus rinds. Limonene is associated with elevated mood, stress relief, and improved gastric motility. Widely used as a natural flavoring and penetration enhancer.

name: Linalool
description: Found abundantly in lavender and over 200 plant species. Linalool demonstrates anxiolytic, sedative, and anticonvulsant properties. It modulates glutamate and GABA neurotransmitter systems.

name: Beta-Caryophyllene
description: A sesquiterpene unique in its ability to bind CB2 cannabinoid receptors. Beta-caryophyllene exhibits potent anti-inflammatory and analgesic activity without psychoactive effects, making it a compelling functional ingredient.

name: Pinene
description: The most widely encountered terpene in nature, found in pine resin, rosemary, and basil. Alpha-pinene acts as a bronchodilator and acetylcholinesterase inhibitor, supporting memory retention and alertness.

name: Terpinolene
description: A multifaceted monoterpene with a complex aromatic profile. Terpinolene shows antioxidant and mildly sedative properties at higher concentrations. Common in nutmeg, tea tree, and select cannabis sativa cultivars.

name: Humulene
description: An isomer of beta-caryophyllene found in hops, sage, and ginseng. Humulene demonstrates appetite-suppressant and anti-inflammatory properties. It is a key contributor to the distinctive aroma of craft beer.

name: Ocimene
description: A monoterpene found in mint, parsley, orchids, and mangoes. Ocimene exhibits antiviral, antifungal, and decongestant properties. Its sweet, complex aroma makes it valuable for premium flavor and fragrance applications.

name: Bisabolol
description: A monocyclic sesquiterpene alcohol derived primarily from chamomile. Bisabolol is prized for anti-irritant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. Its gentle profile makes it ideal for sensitive-skin and calming formulations.

name: Geraniol
description: A monoterpenoid alcohol found in rose oil, citronella, and lemongrass. Geraniol functions as a natural insect repellent and shows neuroprotective potential. Its elegant floral aroma is a staple in perfumery and premium beverages.
